+# 🔬 SPN-134 — historical mobile callback completion
 
 ## Historical mobile callback timeout
 
@@ -42,3 +42,176 @@ allocation and preserved grooming state. Implementation follows the ticket's
 predeclared bounded sample, fatal/incomplete negative controls, complete current
 mobile comparison and owned-resource cleanup. Keep observations separate from
 primary latency samples and preserve every first attempt without credentials.
+
+## Resume checkpoint and bounded diagnostic protocol
+
+2026-11-02 — branch from main `18a8759c498574a1d9cc24a969a558cd97a798ed`.
+Re-read the archived baseline manifest, Playwright report, job log and both
+screenshots before execution. The report records `timedOut`, 420052 ms, with no
+operation stack. The manifest was written before typing and never updated again.
+The fixture only persists before navigation, before typing and after all trace
+collection/cleanup; later in-memory phases cannot survive a terminated worker.
+The first screenshot shows the files dashboard and the second is blank. Neither
+proves completed content or a cause, but the dashboard is consistent with the
+later ordinary route-disposal path. Treat typing, disposal and collection as
+unresolved alternatives rather than assigning the timeout to input.
+
+Discriminating hypothesis: completion or collection may have stalled after the
+last persisted typing checkpoint. Add bounded Node-side phase/progress and owned
+page/browser lifecycle evidence, independently persisted before awaited input,
+trace and cleanup boundaries. Do not add browser protocol calls per key, alter
+SDK callbacks, primary latency samples, the 420000 ms case deadline or trace
+settings. A terminal test hook must preserve the last observation even when the
+body never finishes. Keep the first observed failure separate from later cleanup
+failures and expected closure. Counts contain no typed text, keys, URLs or tokens.
+
+Predeclared sample: one first-attempt baseline/candidate pair per existing
+preset, selected by the normal callback CI job on the committed instrumented
+source. Baseline remains `0e1df4725d9eccb77574d25e3eecdf678fe6ff44`, Node
+26.12.1, locked Playwright 1.64.1 and its installed Chromium (record actual
+version), Ubuntu runner, identical sixteen paragraphs/2086 keydowns and 4x mobile
+throttle. Preserve every result. No scenario retry, timeout extension, forced GC,
+trace-category change or additional sample solely to seek green. A normal sample
+would establish current comparison completion but leave the original attribution
+limit explicit; a repeated failure must identify its last started/completed
+boundary before deciding any further repair. Unit controls cover missing input,
+incomplete trace and unexpected owned lifecycle termination without browser
+execution. Full paired input/content/callback/disposal checks remain required.
+
+Operator gains a bounded first-failure trail; Owner and Collaborator retain the
+unchanged full native workload and content checks; Link guest keeps existing
+access checks. No production behavior changes. M remains appropriate for this
+observation gap; reassess if evidence requires wider native/runtime repair.
+
+
+## Observation implementation and local controls
+
+The callback-only helper keeps at most 128 recent Node-side events plus the first
+observed failure and terminal test status. Paragraph command starts/completions
+and trace byte counts distinguish pending boundaries without logging content or
+adding per-key renderer requests. Expected page/context closure begins only when
+fixture cleanup starts; browser disconnection and crashes remain unexpected.
+The synchronous terminal hook runs independently of a pending renderer or trace
+promise. These observations are diagnostic; the original input/content/trace
+analyzer and paired acceptance remain authoritative.
+
+Trace retention now lives beside its existing reader. It still closes the owned
+stream once; a failed close cannot replace an earlier read error. Source hashes
+include the new helper on both sides; the workflow's explicit callback copy carries it
+to the immutable baseline and existing dependency routing selects both presets.
+
+Local controls: 41 checks passed, including a real Playwright timeout that returns
+failure and retains its terminal checkpoint without browser launch. Actual stream
+controls verify retained bytes/hash, read-plus-close failure precedence and lone
+close failure. Existing incomplete-input, partial/corrupt trace and paired
+acceptance controls remain passing. Scoped strict types and lint passed after
+recorded small repairs. [Raw local results and source hashes](evidence/SPN-134-local.json)
+retain both failures and current results. No native comparison, historical cause,
+cleanup of a real failed native browser, or final review approval is claimed.
+The original ticket stays open; the PR-shape checker intentionally reports its
+not-yet-prepared landing deletion and completion counter. Final acceptance and
+both independent grades remain required before preparing those landing changes.
+
+
+## Independent review repair before the declared native sample
+
+Both nonimplementing reviewers found that synchronous diagnostic-write exceptions
+could mask the first operation error and bypass owned cleanup. They also found
+raw-file creation occurred after stream acquisition but before its closing guard.
+Both are fixed before any native diagnostic execution: progress persistence uses
+one fixed temporary file and atomic rename, preserves the last complete checkpoint,
+and records a bounded error code without throwing into listeners or cleanup.
+The test body and terminal hook reject unavailable evidence after cleanup; an
+existing operation failure stays primary. All operations after stream acquisition,
+including file creation, now share the one-close guard.
+
+44 focused controls pass (1587 ms guarded elapsed, 587.3 MiB peak). New controls
+make the progress destination unwritable, prove the previous checkpoint is intact,
+keep the original trace-read failure when close also fails, allow cleanup phases,
+and prove missing raw-output parent plus failing close retains the original file
+error while still attempting stream close. Scoped strict types and lint pass.
+The first 41-pass snapshot and earlier type/lint failures remain in the raw record;
+current hashes/results distinguish the repair. Source re-review remains pending,
+with native comparison, original attribution and final acceptance still open.
+
+
+The second review found the same masking path in the main acceptance manifest's
+catch/finally writes. Its callback-specific writer now atomically replaces the
+file, returns any existing primary failure, and records a secondary persistence
+failure without throwing past finalization. A previously successful run still
+fails if evidence cannot be saved. Two actual blocked-path controls cover error
+and finalization writes, continued cleanup, original-error identity, preservation
+of previous bytes and later recovery retaining the failure. All 46 controls pass
+(1601 ms, 584.5 MiB); current scoped strict types and lint pass. Raw results name
+the latest checks explicitly and retain both earlier source snapshots. Native
+execution remains deferred until the source repairs are independently cleared.
+
+## 🔎 Current recurrence and resumed diagnostic plan
+
+2026-11-04 — resume PR #248 on main
+`5d8676ec280ac6d5cc9dcedb7e9cc09527b24806` under the owner's request to
+continue resolving SPN-120's failed CI. Preserve the previous diagnostic source
+`f432b5b890f12dc94c330de719e653d0d8b01aad`; its CI41530973166 and
+Storybook41530973045 were cancelled. Those results do not establish completed
+native diagnostics or acceptance. The earlier statement that a copy glob carried
+the helper was wrong for the callback job: its explicit file list now includes
+the observer. The responsiveness job already copies the matching glob.
+
+SPN-141 source `2f1c9304b15adfef833e53f12c4facff9ce14821`, tested merge
+`a554c611c96556176bcc6b2ba006ea421ee00943`, repeated this existing failure in
+CI41885019303 attempt1, mobile callback job126767285654. The immutable baseline
+timed out at420000ms; candidate passed. Independently reviewed raw trace markers
+show291.546s from input-start to final-key and14.992s through disposal/end.
+The gzip stream is readable through EOF:607927866 uncompressed bytes,
+999293 parsed events. A single offline read on Node26.12.1 took8271ms,
+8492ms watchdog elapsed and431600KiB sampled peak. This is local diagnostic
+measurement, not hosted speed or callback acceptance. Trace parsing completed
+without source attribution; the exact interrupted hosted operation is unknown.
+
+📦 [Immutable first failure, trace, reports, independent reviews and offline measurement](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/tree/46a99b8c1786cb9f80695689c70077ce3ef7cf5d/docs/review-assets/spn-134-recurrence-2f1c9304)
+preserves the evidence before another execution. The missing manifest fields
+mean unavailable observations, not observed browser errors or data loss. The
+timeout reached collection/finalization after the browser's end marker; neither
+the earlier run nor this recurrence passes retroactively. No unchanged job rerun
+is justified. SPN-141's native repair remains independently owned and blocked on
+complete selected checks.
+
+The demonstrated defect repaired here is the missing durable boundary/terminal
+record, including primary-error preservation. M remains appropriate: keep the
+existing callback fixture and reader, bounded Node-side observations and all
+product semantics. Operator gets an attributable first failure; Owner,
+Collaborator and Link guest retain unchanged content, input, access and lifetime
+contracts. No generic retry mechanism, broader collection categories or product
+instrumentation is added.
+
+Prospective sample: after both independent qualifying reviews of the complete
+committed candidate, publish one synchronization of PR #248 to run its ordinary
+selected CI, including one first-attempt baseline/candidate pair for each preset.
+The hypothesis is that the diagnostic repair preserves a precise pending
+boundary and terminal cause if completion fails, while complete executions still
+pass the original paired acceptance. Keep Node26.12.1, locked Playwright1.64.1,
+actual recorded Chromium version, baseline0e1df472, 2086 keydowns, mobile4x,
+420000ms, categories/buffer, callback caps and all existing assertions. No failed
+scenario retry or further browser sample is preauthorized by this plan. Inspect
+any failure before a new repair or protocol; a successful pair establishes only
+current completion and leaves the historical attribution limit explicit.
+
+Local controls cover stalled input/trace, terminal timeouts without a browser,
+unexpected owned closure, persistence and stream-close failure precedence,
+truncated/corrupt raw evidence, incomplete input and automatic dependency routing.
+Current source integration passed47 focused controls in1711ms watchdog elapsed,
+610624KiB sampled peak. Final feasible type/lint/backlog checks and both exact-head
+grades precede publication. Hosted comparison, actual cleanup and all seven
+current-head gates remain pending; no grade substitutes for them. Landing
+bookkeeping is prepared before review under the newer review-before-push rule,
+superseding this record's older plan to defer deletion until after CI. The PR
+stays draft until required acceptance and the failure disposition are complete.
+
+✅ [Current local results and source hashes](evidence/SPN-134-resume.json)
+retain the 47 controls, full lint/dependency/format pass, and focused typecheck of
+the callback helpers, validators and tests. Full typecheck was resource-aborted
+at 2145 ms when host memory pressure rose to level 2 (1491424 KiB process tree);
+it remains pending in CI. Focused types do not cover the browser spec, and a
+sub-250 ms run does not measure the native compiler's peak RSS. No owner apps
+were terminated. The repeated failure's precise collection boundary still needs
+the declared instrumented comparison; local controls do not prove native timing.

-# 🔬 SPN-134 Diagnose incomplete historical mobile callback runs
-
-## Story
-
-As the [Operator](../product/personas.md#operator), I want an incomplete historical callback run to identify its failing phase and cause, so that a required comparison can be repaired without uncertain reruns.
-
-## Scenarios
-
-### An incomplete baseline has an evidence-backed disposition
-
-Given the retained historical mobile callback timeout,
-When its owned browser, input, tracing and cleanup boundaries are inspected,
-Then the original failure has a supported cause and bounded repair or explicit follow-up owner,
-And a complete historical/candidate comparison still proves input, content and callback ownership.
-
-## Rules
-
-- Follow [sustainable testing](../testing.md); keep the Verify plan and progress evidence current. [Policy](../implementation/SPN-115.md#guidance-for-every-open-ticket-and-progress-checkpoint), owner 2026-11-01.
-- Preserve the original 420000 ms timeout at the last persisted typing phase; missing counters/analysis are unavailable evidence, not proof of browser errors or data loss. [Origin and diagnostic boundary](../implementation/SPN-134.md#historical-mobile-callback-timeout), agent judgment 2026-11-02, originating in the SPN-071 main push / PR #226.
-- Keep the immutable historical baseline, workload, throttle, first-attempt/no-retry policy, callback caps, input/content checks and existing budgets. A successful candidate or later comparison does not retroactively pass the failed run.
-- Prefer bounded nonsecret phase/process observations in the existing callback fixture. Do not introduce a generic retry framework, instrument primary latency samples or retain credentials/document contents in diagnostics.
-- Initial M covers phase attribution and a bounded fixture/observation repair if demonstrated. Reassess effort before wider investigation; any distinct product defect requires its own evidence-backed scope. Filing a follow-up does not satisfy an unresolved required comparison.
-
-## Out of scope
-
-- SPN-120's named historical fixture cases, native desktop identity/storage cleanup, physical-device provider capability and SPN-133 flush latency.
-- Changing baseline callback behavior, silently skipping a comparison or extending timeouts to obtain a pass.
-
-## Verify
-
-- Inspect the retained baseline partial JSON, job log, failure captures and current callback harness before running anything. Declare a small fixed diagnostic sample, source/browser/runtime and hypothesis; retain all results without assertion retries.
-- Extend the nearest `e2e/doc-responsiveness-callbacks.spec.ts` / fixture / trace-owner tests only where needed. Prove missing input, incomplete tracing and unexpected owned-process exit still fail with the first cause preserved; cleanup must remain bounded.
-- Run the complete existing mobile baseline/candidate comparison on the final source and retain full raw callback evidence, attempt identities, content and input verification, no post-disposal callbacks and cleanup. Verify changed helper/observation dependencies select the required owners. Diagnostics alone do not prove acceptance.

+import { renameSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { rename, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';

+type Lifecycle = 'page-crash' | 'page-close' | 'context-close' | 'browser-disconnected';
+type Failure =
+  | Lifecycle
+  | 'operation'
+  | 'input-observation'
+  | 'trace'
+  | 'detach'
+  | 'fixture-cleanup'
+  | 'manifest-persistence';
+
+/** Preserve a primary fixture error if writing its evidence also fails. */
+export async function persistCallbackManifest(
+  path: string,
+  evidence: Record<string, unknown>,
+  primary: unknown,
+) {
+  try {
+    await writeFile(`${path}.tmp`, JSON.stringify(evidence, null, 2) + '\n');
+    await rename(`${path}.tmp`, path);
+  } catch {
+    evidence.manifestPersistenceError = true;
+    evidence.passed = false;
+    return primary ?? new Error('Callback acceptance manifest could not be persisted.');
+  }
+  return primary;
+}
+
+/** Node-side observations survive a test-body timeout without querying the renderer.
+ * This is diagnostic evidence only: it cannot replace native acceptance results. */

+## Resume checkpoint and bounded diagnostic protocol
+

+later ordinary route-disposal path. Treat typing, disposal and collection as
+unresolved alternatives rather than assigning the timeout to input.

+last persisted typing checkpoint. Add bounded Node-side phase/progress and owned
+page/browser lifecycle evidence, independently persisted before awaited input,
+trace and cleanup boundaries. Do not add browser protocol calls per key, alter
+SDK callbacks, primary latency samples, the 420000 ms case deadline or trace
+settings. A terminal test hook must preserve the last observation even when the

+failures and expected closure. Counts contain no typed text, keys, URLs or tokens.

+source. Baseline remains `0e1df4725d9eccb77574d25e3eecdf678fe6ff44`, Node

+## Observation implementation and local controls
+
+The callback-only helper keeps at most 128 recent Node-side events plus the first
+observed failure and terminal test status. Paragraph command starts/completions
+and trace byte counts distinguish pending boundaries without logging content or
+adding per-key renderer requests. Expected page/context closure begins only when
+fixture cleanup starts; browser disconnection and crashes remain unexpected.

+promise. These observations are diagnostic; the original input/content/trace
+analyzer and paired acceptance remain authoritative.

+stream once; a failed close cannot replace an earlier read error. Source hashes

+Both are fixed before any native diagnostic execution: progress persistence uses

+/** Preserve a primary fixture error if writing its evidence also fails. */
+export async function persistCallbackManifest(
+  path: string,
+  evidence: Record<string, unknown>,
+  primary: unknown,
+) {
+  try {
+    await writeFile(`${path}.tmp`, JSON.stringify(evidence, null, 2) + '\n');
+    await rename(`${path}.tmp`, path);
+  } catch {
+    evidence.manifestPersistenceError = true;
+    evidence.passed = false;

-# 🔬 SPN-134 Diagnose incomplete historical mobile callback runs
-
-## Story
-
-As the [Operator](../product/personas.md#operator), I want an incomplete historical callback run to identify its failing phase and cause, so that a required comparison can be repaired without uncertain reruns.
-
-## Scenarios
-
-### An incomplete baseline has an evidence-backed disposition
-
-Given the retained historical mobile callback timeout,
-When its owned browser, input, tracing and cleanup boundaries are inspected,
-Then the original failure has a supported cause and bounded repair or explicit follow-up owner,
-And a complete historical/candidate comparison still proves input, content and callback ownership.
-
-## Rules
-
-- Follow [sustainable testing](../testing.md); keep the Verify plan and progress evidence current. [Policy](../implementation/SPN-115.md#guidance-for-every-open-ticket-and-progress-checkpoint), owner 2026-11-01.
-- Preserve the original 420000 ms timeout at the last persisted typing phase; missing counters/analysis are unavailable evidence, not proof of browser errors or data loss. [Origin and diagnostic boundary](../implementation/SPN-134.md#historical-mobile-callback-timeout), agent judgment 2026-11-02, originating in the SPN-071 main push / PR #226.
-- Keep the immutable historical baseline, workload, throttle, first-attempt/no-retry policy, callback caps, input/content checks and existing budgets. A successful candidate or later comparison does not retroactively pass the failed run.
-- Prefer bounded nonsecret phase/process observations in the existing callback fixture. Do not introduce a generic retry framework, instrument primary latency samples or retain credentials/document contents in diagnostics.
-- Initial M covers phase attribution and a bounded fixture/observation repair if demonstrated. Reassess effort before wider investigation; any distinct product defect requires its own evidence-backed scope. Filing a follow-up does not satisfy an unresolved required comparison.
-
-## Out of scope
-
-- SPN-120's named historical fixture cases, native desktop identity/storage cleanup, physical-device provider capability and SPN-133 flush latency.
-- Changing baseline callback behavior, silently skipping a comparison or extending timeouts to obtain a pass.
-
-## Verify
-
-- Inspect the retained baseline partial JSON, job log, failure captures and current callback harness before running anything. Declare a small fixed diagnostic sample, source/browser/runtime and hypothesis; retain all results without assertion retries.
-- Extend the nearest `e2e/doc-responsiveness-callbacks.spec.ts` / fixture / trace-owner tests only where needed. Prove missing input, incomplete tracing and unexpected owned-process exit still fail with the first cause preserved; cleanup must remain bounded.
-- Run the complete existing mobile baseline/candidate comparison on the final source and retain full raw callback evidence, attempt identities, content and input verification, no post-disposal callbacks and cleanup. Verify changed helper/observation dependencies select the required owners. Diagnostics alone do not prove acceptance.

+/** Preserve a primary fixture error if writing its evidence also fails. */
+export async function persistCallbackManifest(
+  path: string,
+  evidence: Record<string, unknown>,
+  primary: unknown,
+) {
+  try {
+    await writeFile(`${path}.tmp`, JSON.stringify(evidence, null, 2) + '\n');
+    await rename(`${path}.tmp`, path);
+  } catch {
+    evidence.manifestPersistenceError = true;
+    evidence.passed = false;
+    return primary ?? new Error('Callback acceptance manifest could not be persisted.');
+  }

-# 🔬 SPN-134 Diagnose incomplete historical mobile callback runs
-
-## Story
-
-As the [Operator](../product/personas.md#operator), I want an incomplete historical callback run to identify its failing phase and cause, so that a required comparison can be repaired without uncertain reruns.
-
-## Scenarios
-
-### An incomplete baseline has an evidence-backed disposition
-
-Given the retained historical mobile callback timeout,
-When its owned browser, input, tracing and cleanup boundaries are inspected,
-Then the original failure has a supported cause and bounded repair or explicit follow-up owner,
-And a complete historical/candidate comparison still proves input, content and callback ownership.
-
-## Rules
-
-- Follow [sustainable testing](../testing.md); keep the Verify plan and progress evidence current. [Policy](../implementation/SPN-115.md#guidance-for-every-open-ticket-and-progress-checkpoint), owner 2026-11-01.
-- Preserve the original 420000 ms timeout at the last persisted typing phase; missing counters/analysis are unavailable evidence, not proof of browser errors or data loss. [Origin and diagnostic boundary](../implementation/SPN-134.md#historical-mobile-callback-timeout), agent judgment 2026-11-02, originating in the SPN-071 main push / PR #226.
-- Keep the immutable historical baseline, workload, throttle, first-attempt/no-retry policy, callback caps, input/content checks and existing budgets. A successful candidate or later comparison does not retroactively pass the failed run.
-- Prefer bounded nonsecret phase/process observations in the existing callback fixture. Do not introduce a generic retry framework, instrument primary latency samples or retain credentials/document contents in diagnostics.
-- Initial M covers phase attribution and a bounded fixture/observation repair if demonstrated. Reassess effort before wider investigation; any distinct product defect requires its own evidence-backed scope. Filing a follow-up does not satisfy an unresolved required comparison.
-
-## Out of scope
-
-- SPN-120's named historical fixture cases, native desktop identity/storage cleanup, physical-device provider capability and SPN-133 flush latency.
-- Changing baseline callback behavior, silently skipping a comparison or extending timeouts to obtain a pass.
-
-## Verify
-
-- Inspect the retained baseline partial JSON, job log, failure captures and current callback harness before running anything. Declare a small fixed diagnostic sample, source/browser/runtime and hypothesis; retain all results without assertion retries.
-- Extend the nearest `e2e/doc-responsiveness-callbacks.spec.ts` / fixture / trace-owner tests only where needed. Prove missing input, incomplete tracing and unexpected owned-process exit still fail with the first cause preserved; cleanup must remain bounded.
-- Run the complete existing mobile baseline/candidate comparison on the final source and retain full raw callback evidence, attempt identities, content and input verification, no post-disposal callbacks and cleanup. Verify changed helper/observation dependencies select the required owners. Diagnostics alone do not prove acceptance.

+import { renameSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { rename, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
+
+type Lifecycle = 'page-crash' | 'page-close' | 'context-close' | 'browser-disconnected';
+type Failure =
+  | Lifecycle
+  | 'operation'
+  | 'input-observation'
+  | 'trace'
+  | 'detach'
+  | 'fixture-cleanup'
+  | 'manifest-persistence';
+
+/** Preserve a primary fixture error if writing its evidence also fails. */
+export async function persistCallbackManifest(
+  path: string,
+  evidence: Record<string, unknown>,
+  primary: unknown,
+) {
+  try {
+    await writeFile(`${path}.tmp`, JSON.stringify(evidence, null, 2) + '\n');
+    await rename(`${path}.tmp`, path);
+  } catch {
+    evidence.manifestPersistenceError = true;
+    evidence.passed = false;
+    return primary ?? new Error('Callback acceptance manifest could not be persisted.');
+  }
+  return primary;
+}

-# 🔬 SPN-134 Diagnose incomplete historical mobile callback runs
-
-## Story
-
-As the [Operator](../product/personas.md#operator), I want an incomplete historical callback run to identify its failing phase and cause, so that a required comparison can be repaired without uncertain reruns.
-
-## Scenarios
-
-### An incomplete baseline has an evidence-backed disposition
-
-Given the retained historical mobile callback timeout,
-When its owned browser, input, tracing and cleanup boundaries are inspected,
-Then the original failure has a supported cause and bounded repair or explicit follow-up owner,
-And a complete historical/candidate comparison still proves input, content and callback ownership.
-
-## Rules
-
-- Follow [sustainable testing](../testing.md); keep the Verify plan and progress evidence current. [Policy](../implementation/SPN-115.md#guidance-for-every-open-ticket-and-progress-checkpoint), owner 2026-11-01.
-- Preserve the original 420000 ms timeout at the last persisted typing phase; missing counters/analysis are unavailable evidence, not proof of browser errors or data loss. [Origin and diagnostic boundary](../implementation/SPN-134.md#historical-mobile-callback-timeout), agent judgment 2026-11-02, originating in the SPN-071 main push / PR #226.
-- Keep the immutable historical baseline, workload, throttle, first-attempt/no-retry policy, callback caps, input/content checks and existing budgets. A successful candidate or later comparison does not retroactively pass the failed run.
-- Prefer bounded nonsecret phase/process observations in the existing callback fixture. Do not introduce a generic retry framework, instrument primary latency samples or retain credentials/document contents in diagnostics.
-- Initial M covers phase attribution and a bounded fixture/observation repair if demonstrated. Reassess effort before wider investigation; any distinct product defect requires its own evidence-backed scope. Filing a follow-up does not satisfy an unresolved required comparison.
-
-## Out of scope
-
-- SPN-120's named historical fixture cases, native desktop identity/storage cleanup, physical-device provider capability and SPN-133 flush latency.
-- Changing baseline callback behavior, silently skipping a comparison or extending timeouts to obtain a pass.
-
-## Verify
-
-- Inspect the retained baseline partial JSON, job log, failure captures and current callback harness before running anything. Declare a small fixed diagnostic sample, source/browser/runtime and hypothesis; retain all results without assertion retries.
-- Extend the nearest `e2e/doc-responsiveness-callbacks.spec.ts` / fixture / trace-owner tests only where needed. Prove missing input, incomplete tracing and unexpected owned-process exit still fail with the first cause preserved; cleanup must remain bounded.
-- Run the complete existing mobile baseline/candidate comparison on the final source and retain full raw callback evidence, attempt identities, content and input verification, no post-disposal callbacks and cleanup. Verify changed helper/observation dependencies select the required owners. Diagnostics alone do not prove acceptance.

+import { renameSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { rename, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
+
+type Lifecycle = 'page-crash' | 'page-close' | 'context-close' | 'browser-disconnected';
+type Failure =
+  | Lifecycle
+  | 'operation'
+  | 'input-observation'
+  | 'trace'
+  | 'detach'
+  | 'fixture-cleanup'
+  | 'manifest-persistence';
+
+/** Preserve a primary fixture error if writing its evidence also fails. */
+export async function persistCallbackManifest(
+  path: string,
+  evidence: Record<string, unknown>,
+  primary: unknown,
+) {
+  try {
+    await writeFile(`${path}.tmp`, JSON.stringify(evidence, null, 2) + '\n');
+    await rename(`${path}.tmp`, path);
+  } catch {
+    evidence.manifestPersistenceError = true;
+    evidence.passed = false;
+    return primary ?? new Error('Callback acceptance manifest could not be persisted.');
+  }
+  return primary;
+}
+
+/** Node-side observations survive a test-body timeout without querying the renderer.
+ * This is diagnostic evidence only: it cannot replace native acceptance results. */
+export function callbackProgress(path: string) {
+  const started = performance.now();
+  let cleanupExpected = false;
+  let phase = 'fixture';
+  const events: Array<{
+    atMs: number;
+    phase: string;
+    kind: string;
+    count?: number;
+    expected?: boolean;
+  }> = [];
+  let firstFailure: { atMs: number; phase: string; kind: string } | null = null;
+  let droppedEvents = 0;
+  let terminal: string | null = null;
+  let persistenceFailure: { atMs: number; phase: string; code: string } | null = null;
+  const record = (kind: string, extra: { count?: number; expected?: boolean } = {}) => {
+    events.push({ atMs: performance.now() - started, phase, kind, ...extra });
+    // Fixed memory/disk bound even if a broken target emits repeated lifecycle events.
+    if (events.length > 128) {
+      events.shift();
+      droppedEvents++;
+    }
+    try {
+      // Keep the previous complete checkpoint if a write or rename fails. The
+      // fixed temporary path bounds abandoned storage to one additional file.

+# 🔬 SPN-134 — historical mobile callback completion
 
 ## Historical mobile callback timeout
 
@@ -42,3 +42,176 @@ allocation and preserved grooming state. Implementation follows the ticket's
 predeclared bounded sample, fatal/incomplete negative controls, complete current
 mobile comparison and owned-resource cleanup. Keep observations separate from
 primary latency samples and preserve every first attempt without credentials.
+
+## Resume checkpoint and bounded diagnostic protocol
+
+2026-11-02 — branch from main `18a8759c498574a1d9cc24a969a558cd97a798ed`.
+Re-read the archived baseline manifest, Playwright report, job log and both
+screenshots before execution. The report records `timedOut`, 420052 ms, with no
+operation stack. The manifest was written before typing and never updated again.
+The fixture only persists before navigation, before typing and after all trace
+collection/cleanup; later in-memory phases cannot survive a terminated worker.
+The first screenshot shows the files dashboard and the second is blank. Neither
+proves completed content or a cause, but the dashboard is consistent with the
+later ordinary route-disposal path. Treat typing, disposal and collection as
+unresolved alternatives rather than assigning the timeout to input.
+
+Discriminating hypothesis: completion or collection may have stalled after the
+last persisted typing checkpoint. Add bounded Node-side phase/progress and owned
+page/browser lifecycle evidence, independently persisted before awaited input,
+trace and cleanup boundaries. Do not add browser protocol calls per key, alter
+SDK callbacks, primary latency samples, the 420000 ms case deadline or trace
+settings. A terminal test hook must preserve the last observation even when the
+body never finishes. Keep the first observed failure separate from later cleanup
+failures and expected closure. Counts contain no typed text, keys, URLs or tokens.
+
+Predeclared sample: one first-attempt baseline/candidate pair per existing
+preset, selected by the normal callback CI job on the committed instrumented
+source. Baseline remains `0e1df4725d9eccb77574d25e3eecdf678fe6ff44`, Node
+26.12.1, locked Playwright 1.64.1 and its installed Chromium (record actual
+version), Ubuntu runner, identical sixteen paragraphs/2086 keydowns and 4x mobile
+throttle. Preserve every result. No scenario retry, timeout extension, forced GC,
+trace-category change or additional sample solely to seek green. A normal sample
+would establish current comparison completion but leave the original attribution
+limit explicit; a repeated failure must identify its last started/completed
+boundary before deciding any further repair. Unit controls cover missing input,
+incomplete trace and unexpected owned lifecycle termination without browser
+execution. Full paired input/content/callback/disposal checks remain required.
+
+Operator gains a bounded first-failure trail; Owner and Collaborator retain the
+unchanged full native workload and content checks; Link guest keeps existing
+access checks. No production behavior changes. M remains appropriate for this
+observation gap; reassess if evidence requires wider native/runtime repair.
+
+
+## Observation implementation and local controls
+
+The callback-only helper keeps at most 128 recent Node-side events plus the first
+observed failure and terminal test status. Paragraph command starts/completions
+and trace byte counts distinguish pending boundaries without logging content or
+adding per-key renderer requests. Expected page/context closure begins only when
+fixture cleanup starts; browser disconnection and crashes remain unexpected.
+The synchronous terminal hook runs independently of a pending renderer or trace
+promise. These observations are diagnostic; the original input/content/trace
+analyzer and paired acceptance remain authoritative.
+
+Trace retention now lives beside its existing reader. It still closes the owned
+stream once; a failed close cannot replace an earlier read error. Source hashes
+include the new helper on both sides; the workflow's explicit callback copy carries it
+to the immutable baseline and existing dependency routing selects both presets.
+
+Local controls: 41 checks passed, including a real Playwright timeout that returns
+failure and retains its terminal checkpoint without browser launch. Actual stream
+controls verify retained bytes/hash, read-plus-close failure precedence and lone
+close failure. Existing incomplete-input, partial/corrupt trace and paired
+acceptance controls remain passing. Scoped strict types and lint passed after
+recorded small repairs. [Raw local results and source hashes](evidence/SPN-134-local.json)
+retain both failures and current results. No native comparison, historical cause,
+cleanup of a real failed native browser, or final review approval is claimed.
+The original ticket stays open; the PR-shape checker intentionally reports its
+not-yet-prepared landing deletion and completion counter. Final acceptance and
+both independent grades remain required before preparing those landing changes.
+
+
+## Independent review repair before the declared native sample
+
+Both nonimplementing reviewers found that synchronous diagnostic-write exceptions
+could mask the first operation error and bypass owned cleanup. They also found
+raw-file creation occurred after stream acquisition but before its closing guard.
+Both are fixed before any native diagnostic execution: progress persistence uses
+one fixed temporary file and atomic rename, preserves the last complete checkpoint,
+and records a bounded error code without throwing into listeners or cleanup.
+The test body and terminal hook reject unavailable evidence after cleanup; an
+existing operation failure stays primary. All operations after stream acquisition,
+including file creation, now share the one-close guard.
+
+44 focused controls pass (1587 ms guarded elapsed, 587.3 MiB peak). New controls
+make the progress destination unwritable, prove the previous checkpoint is intact,
+keep the original trace-read failure when close also fails, allow cleanup phases,
+and prove missing raw-output parent plus failing close retains the original file
+error while still attempting stream close. Scoped strict types and lint pass.
+The first 41-pass snapshot and earlier type/lint failures remain in the raw record;
+current hashes/results distinguish the repair. Source re-review remains pending,
+with native comparison, original attribution and final acceptance still open.
+
+
+The second review found the same masking path in the main acceptance manifest's
+catch/finally writes. Its callback-specific writer now atomically replaces the
+file, returns any existing primary failure, and records a secondary persistence
+failure without throwing past finalization. A previously successful run still
+fails if evidence cannot be saved. Two actual blocked-path controls cover error
+and finalization writes, continued cleanup, original-error identity, preservation
+of previous bytes and later recovery retaining the failure. All 46 controls pass
+(1601 ms, 584.5 MiB); current scoped strict types and lint pass. Raw results name
+the latest checks explicitly and retain both earlier source snapshots. Native
+execution remains deferred until the source repairs are independently cleared.
+
+## 🔎 Current recurrence and resumed diagnostic plan
+
+2026-11-04 — resume PR #248 on main
+`5d8676ec280ac6d5cc9dcedb7e9cc09527b24806` under the owner's request to
+continue resolving SPN-120's failed CI. Preserve the previous diagnostic source
+`f432b5b890f12dc94c330de719e653d0d8b01aad`; its CI41530973166 and
+Storybook41530973045 were cancelled. Those results do not establish completed
+native diagnostics or acceptance. The earlier statement that a copy glob carried
+the helper was wrong for the callback job: its explicit file list now includes
+the observer. The responsiveness job already copies the matching glob.
+
+SPN-141 source `2f1c9304b15adfef833e53f12c4facff9ce14821`, tested merge
+`a554c611c96556176bcc6b2ba006ea421ee00943`, repeated this existing failure in
+CI41885019303 attempt1, mobile callback job126767285654. The immutable baseline
+timed out at420000ms; candidate passed. Independently reviewed raw trace markers
+show291.546s from input-start to final-key and14.992s through disposal/end.
+The gzip stream is readable through EOF:607927866 uncompressed bytes,
+999293 parsed events. A single offline read on Node26.12.1 took8271ms,
+8492ms watchdog elapsed and431600KiB sampled peak. This is local diagnostic
+measurement, not hosted speed or callback acceptance. Trace parsing completed
+without source attribution; the exact interrupted hosted operation is unknown.
+
+📦 [Immutable first failure, trace, reports, independent reviews and offline measurement](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/tree/46a99b8c1786cb9f80695689c70077ce3ef7cf5d/docs/review-assets/spn-134-recurrence-2f1c9304)
+preserves the evidence before another execution. The missing manifest fields
+mean unavailable observations, not observed browser errors or data loss. The
+timeout reached collection/finalization after the browser's end marker; neither
+the earlier run nor this recurrence passes retroactively. No unchanged job rerun
+is justified. SPN-141's native repair remains independently owned and blocked on
+complete selected checks.
+
+The demonstrated defect repaired here is the missing durable boundary/terminal
+record, including primary-error preservation. M remains appropriate: keep the
+existing callback fixture and reader, bounded Node-side observations and all
+product semantics. Operator gets an attributable first failure; Owner,
+Collaborator and Link guest retain unchanged content, input, access and lifetime
+contracts. No generic retry mechanism, broader collection categories or product
+instrumentation is added.
+
+Prospective sample: after both independent qualifying reviews of the complete
+committed candidate, publish one synchronization of PR #248 to run its ordinary
+selected CI, including one first-attempt baseline/candidate pair for each preset.
+The hypothesis is that the diagnostic repair preserves a precise pending
+boundary and terminal cause if completion fails, while complete executions still
+pass the original paired acceptance. Keep Node26.12.1, locked Playwright1.64.1,
+actual recorded Chromium version, baseline0e1df472, 2086 keydowns, mobile4x,
+420000ms, categories/buffer, callback caps and all existing assertions. No failed
+scenario retry or further browser sample is preauthorized by this plan. Inspect
+any failure before a new repair or protocol; a successful pair establishes only
+current completion and leaves the historical attribution limit explicit.
+
+Local controls cover stalled input/trace, terminal timeouts without a browser,
+unexpected owned closure, persistence and stream-close failure precedence,
+truncated/corrupt raw evidence, incomplete input and automatic dependency routing.
+Current source integration passed47 focused controls in1711ms watchdog elapsed,
+610624KiB sampled peak. Final feasible type/lint/backlog checks and both exact-head
+grades precede publication. Hosted comparison, actual cleanup and all seven
+current-head gates remain pending; no grade substitutes for them. Landing
+bookkeeping is prepared before review under the newer review-before-push rule,
+superseding this record's older plan to defer deletion until after CI. The PR
+stays draft until required acceptance and the failure disposition are complete.
+
+✅ [Current local results and source hashes](evidence/SPN-134-resume.json)
+retain the 47 controls, full lint/dependency/format pass, and focused typecheck of
+the callback helpers, validators and tests. Full typecheck was resource-aborted
+at 2145 ms when host memory pressure rose to level 2 (1491424 KiB process tree);
+it remains pending in CI. Focused types do not cover the browser spec, and a
+sub-250 ms run does not measure the native compiler's peak RSS. No owner apps
+were terminated. The repeated failure's precise collection boundary still needs
+the declared instrumented comparison; local controls do not prove native timing.

-# 🔬 SPN-134 Diagnose incomplete historical mobile callback runs
-
-## Story
-
-As the [Operator](../product/personas.md#operator), I want an incomplete historical callback run to identify its failing phase and cause, so that a required comparison can be repaired without uncertain reruns.
-
-## Scenarios
-
-### An incomplete baseline has an evidence-backed disposition
-
-Given the retained historical mobile callback timeout,
-When its owned browser, input, tracing and cleanup boundaries are inspected,
-Then the original failure has a supported cause and bounded repair or explicit follow-up owner,
-And a complete historical/candidate comparison still proves input, content and callback ownership.
-
-## Rules
-
-- Follow [sustainable testing](../testing.md); keep the Verify plan and progress evidence current. [Policy](../implementation/SPN-115.md#guidance-for-every-open-ticket-and-progress-checkpoint), owner 2026-11-01.
-- Preserve the original 420000 ms timeout at the last persisted typing phase; missing counters/analysis are unavailable evidence, not proof of browser errors or data loss. [Origin and diagnostic boundary](../implementation/SPN-134.md#historical-mobile-callback-timeout), agent judgment 2026-11-02, originating in the SPN-071 main push / PR #226.
-- Keep the immutable historical baseline, workload, throttle, first-attempt/no-retry policy, callback caps, input/content checks and existing budgets. A successful candidate or later comparison does not retroactively pass the failed run.
-- Prefer bounded nonsecret phase/process observations in the existing callback fixture. Do not introduce a generic retry framework, instrument primary latency samples or retain credentials/document contents in diagnostics.
-- Initial M covers phase attribution and a bounded fixture/observation repair if demonstrated. Reassess effort before wider investigation; any distinct product defect requires its own evidence-backed scope. Filing a follow-up does not satisfy an unresolved required comparison.
-
-## Out of scope
-
-- SPN-120's named historical fixture cases, native desktop identity/storage cleanup, physical-device provider capability and SPN-133 flush latency.
-- Changing baseline callback behavior, silently skipping a comparison or extending timeouts to obtain a pass.
-
-## Verify
-
-- Inspect the retained baseline partial JSON, job log, failure captures and current callback harness before running anything. Declare a small fixed diagnostic sample, source/browser/runtime and hypothesis; retain all results without assertion retries.
-- Extend the nearest `e2e/doc-responsiveness-callbacks.spec.ts` / fixture / trace-owner tests only where needed. Prove missing input, incomplete tracing and unexpected owned-process exit still fail with the first cause preserved; cleanup must remain bounded.
-- Run the complete existing mobile baseline/candidate comparison on the final source and retain full raw callback evidence, attempt identities, content and input verification, no post-disposal callbacks and cleanup. Verify changed helper/observation dependencies select the required owners. Diagnostics alone do not prove acceptance.

+import { renameSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { rename, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';

+type Lifecycle = 'page-crash' | 'page-close' | 'context-close' | 'browser-disconnected';
+type Failure =
+  | Lifecycle
+  | 'operation'
+  | 'input-observation'
+  | 'trace'
+  | 'detach'
+  | 'fixture-cleanup'
+  | 'manifest-persistence';
+
+/** Preserve a primary fixture error if writing its evidence also fails. */
+export async function persistCallbackManifest(
+  path: string,
+  evidence: Record<string, unknown>,
+  primary: unknown,
+) {
+  try {
+    await writeFile(`${path}.tmp`, JSON.stringify(evidence, null, 2) + '\n');
+    await rename(`${path}.tmp`, path);
+  } catch {
+    evidence.manifestPersistenceError = true;
+    evidence.passed = false;
+    return primary ?? new Error('Callback acceptance manifest could not be persisted.');
+  }
+  return primary;
+}
+
+/** Node-side observations survive a test-body timeout without querying the renderer.
+ * This is diagnostic evidence only: it cannot replace native acceptance results. */

+## Resume checkpoint and bounded diagnostic protocol
+

+later ordinary route-disposal path. Treat typing, disposal and collection as
+unresolved alternatives rather than assigning the timeout to input.

+last persisted typing checkpoint. Add bounded Node-side phase/progress and owned
+page/browser lifecycle evidence, independently persisted before awaited input,
+trace and cleanup boundaries. Do not add browser protocol calls per key, alter
+SDK callbacks, primary latency samples, the 420000 ms case deadline or trace
+settings. A terminal test hook must preserve the last observation even when the

+failures and expected closure. Counts contain no typed text, keys, URLs or tokens.

+source. Baseline remains `0e1df4725d9eccb77574d25e3eecdf678fe6ff44`, Node

+## Observation implementation and local controls
+
+The callback-only helper keeps at most 128 recent Node-side events plus the first
+observed failure and terminal test status. Paragraph command starts/completions
+and trace byte counts distinguish pending boundaries without logging content or
+adding per-key renderer requests. Expected page/context closure begins only when
+fixture cleanup starts; browser disconnection and crashes remain unexpected.

+promise. These observations are diagnostic; the original input/content/trace
+analyzer and paired acceptance remain authoritative.

+stream once; a failed close cannot replace an earlier read error. Source hashes

+Both are fixed before any native diagnostic execution: progress persistence uses

+/** Preserve a primary fixture error if writing its evidence also fails. */
+export async function persistCallbackManifest(
+  path: string,
+  evidence: Record<string, unknown>,
+  primary: unknown,
+) {
+  try {
+    await writeFile(`${path}.tmp`, JSON.stringify(evidence, null, 2) + '\n');
+    await rename(`${path}.tmp`, path);
+  } catch {
+    evidence.manifestPersistenceError = true;
+    evidence.passed = false;

-# 🔬 SPN-134 Diagnose incomplete historical mobile callback runs
-
-## Story
-
-As the [Operator](../product/personas.md#operator), I want an incomplete historical callback run to identify its failing phase and cause, so that a required comparison can be repaired without uncertain reruns.
-
-## Scenarios
-
-### An incomplete baseline has an evidence-backed disposition
-
-Given the retained historical mobile callback timeout,
-When its owned browser, input, tracing and cleanup boundaries are inspected,
-Then the original failure has a supported cause and bounded repair or explicit follow-up owner,
-And a complete historical/candidate comparison still proves input, content and callback ownership.
-
-## Rules
-
-- Follow [sustainable testing](../testing.md); keep the Verify plan and progress evidence current. [Policy](../implementation/SPN-115.md#guidance-for-every-open-ticket-and-progress-checkpoint), owner 2026-11-01.
-- Preserve the original 420000 ms timeout at the last persisted typing phase; missing counters/analysis are unavailable evidence, not proof of browser errors or data loss. [Origin and diagnostic boundary](../implementation/SPN-134.md#historical-mobile-callback-timeout), agent judgment 2026-11-02, originating in the SPN-071 main push / PR #226.
-- Keep the immutable historical baseline, workload, throttle, first-attempt/no-retry policy, callback caps, input/content checks and existing budgets. A successful candidate or later comparison does not retroactively pass the failed run.
-- Prefer bounded nonsecret phase/process observations in the existing callback fixture. Do not introduce a generic retry framework, instrument primary latency samples or retain credentials/document contents in diagnostics.
-- Initial M covers phase attribution and a bounded fixture/observation repair if demonstrated. Reassess effort before wider investigation; any distinct product defect requires its own evidence-backed scope. Filing a follow-up does not satisfy an unresolved required comparison.
-
-## Out of scope
-
-- SPN-120's named historical fixture cases, native desktop identity/storage cleanup, physical-device provider capability and SPN-133 flush latency.
-- Changing baseline callback behavior, silently skipping a comparison or extending timeouts to obtain a pass.
-
-## Verify
-
-- Inspect the retained baseline partial JSON, job log, failure captures and current callback harness before running anything. Declare a small fixed diagnostic sample, source/browser/runtime and hypothesis; retain all results without assertion retries.
-- Extend the nearest `e2e/doc-responsiveness-callbacks.spec.ts` / fixture / trace-owner tests only where needed. Prove missing input, incomplete tracing and unexpected owned-process exit still fail with the first cause preserved; cleanup must remain bounded.
-- Run the complete existing mobile baseline/candidate comparison on the final source and retain full raw callback evidence, attempt identities, content and input verification, no post-disposal callbacks and cleanup. Verify changed helper/observation dependencies select the required owners. Diagnostics alone do not prove acceptance.

+/** Preserve a primary fixture error if writing its evidence also fails. */
+export async function persistCallbackManifest(
+  path: string,
+  evidence: Record<string, unknown>,
+  primary: unknown,
+) {
+  try {
+    await writeFile(`${path}.tmp`, JSON.stringify(evidence, null, 2) + '\n');
+    await rename(`${path}.tmp`, path);
+  } catch {
+    evidence.manifestPersistenceError = true;
+    evidence.passed = false;
+    return primary ?? new Error('Callback acceptance manifest could not be persisted.');
+  }

-# 🔬 SPN-134 Diagnose incomplete historical mobile callback runs
-
-## Story
-
-As the [Operator](../product/personas.md#operator), I want an incomplete historical callback run to identify its failing phase and cause, so that a required comparison can be repaired without uncertain reruns.
-
-## Scenarios
-
-### An incomplete baseline has an evidence-backed disposition
-
-Given the retained historical mobile callback timeout,
-When its owned browser, input, tracing and cleanup boundaries are inspected,
-Then the original failure has a supported cause and bounded repair or explicit follow-up owner,
-And a complete historical/candidate comparison still proves input, content and callback ownership.
-
-## Rules
-
-- Follow [sustainable testing](../testing.md); keep the Verify plan and progress evidence current. [Policy](../implementation/SPN-115.md#guidance-for-every-open-ticket-and-progress-checkpoint), owner 2026-11-01.
-- Preserve the original 420000 ms timeout at the last persisted typing phase; missing counters/analysis are unavailable evidence, not proof of browser errors or data loss. [Origin and diagnostic boundary](../implementation/SPN-134.md#historical-mobile-callback-timeout), agent judgment 2026-11-02, originating in the SPN-071 main push / PR #226.
-- Keep the immutable historical baseline, workload, throttle, first-attempt/no-retry policy, callback caps, input/content checks and existing budgets. A successful candidate or later comparison does not retroactively pass the failed run.
-- Prefer bounded nonsecret phase/process observations in the existing callback fixture. Do not introduce a generic retry framework, instrument primary latency samples or retain credentials/document contents in diagnostics.
-- Initial M covers phase attribution and a bounded fixture/observation repair if demonstrated. Reassess effort before wider investigation; any distinct product defect requires its own evidence-backed scope. Filing a follow-up does not satisfy an unresolved required comparison.
-
-## Out of scope
-
-- SPN-120's named historical fixture cases, native desktop identity/storage cleanup, physical-device provider capability and SPN-133 flush latency.
-- Changing baseline callback behavior, silently skipping a comparison or extending timeouts to obtain a pass.
-
-## Verify
-
-- Inspect the retained baseline partial JSON, job log, failure captures and current callback harness before running anything. Declare a small fixed diagnostic sample, source/browser/runtime and hypothesis; retain all results without assertion retries.
-- Extend the nearest `e2e/doc-responsiveness-callbacks.spec.ts` / fixture / trace-owner tests only where needed. Prove missing input, incomplete tracing and unexpected owned-process exit still fail with the first cause preserved; cleanup must remain bounded.
-- Run the complete existing mobile baseline/candidate comparison on the final source and retain full raw callback evidence, attempt identities, content and input verification, no post-disposal callbacks and cleanup. Verify changed helper/observation dependencies select the required owners. Diagnostics alone do not prove acceptance.

+import { renameSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { rename, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
+
+type Lifecycle = 'page-crash' | 'page-close' | 'context-close' | 'browser-disconnected';
+type Failure =
+  | Lifecycle
+  | 'operation'
+  | 'input-observation'
+  | 'trace'
+  | 'detach'
+  | 'fixture-cleanup'
+  | 'manifest-persistence';
+
+/** Preserve a primary fixture error if writing its evidence also fails. */
+export async function persistCallbackManifest(
+  path: string,
+  evidence: Record<string, unknown>,
+  primary: unknown,
+) {
+  try {
+    await writeFile(`${path}.tmp`, JSON.stringify(evidence, null, 2) + '\n');
+    await rename(`${path}.tmp`, path);
+  } catch {
+    evidence.manifestPersistenceError = true;
+    evidence.passed = false;
+    return primary ?? new Error('Callback acceptance manifest could not be persisted.');
+  }
+  return primary;
+}

-# 🔬 SPN-134 Diagnose incomplete historical mobile callback runs
-
-## Story
-
-As the [Operator](../product/personas.md#operator), I want an incomplete historical callback run to identify its failing phase and cause, so that a required comparison can be repaired without uncertain reruns.
-
-## Scenarios
-
-### An incomplete baseline has an evidence-backed disposition
-
-Given the retained historical mobile callback timeout,
-When its owned browser, input, tracing and cleanup boundaries are inspected,
-Then the original failure has a supported cause and bounded repair or explicit follow-up owner,
-And a complete historical/candidate comparison still proves input, content and callback ownership.
-
-## Rules
-
-- Follow [sustainable testing](../testing.md); keep the Verify plan and progress evidence current. [Policy](../implementation/SPN-115.md#guidance-for-every-open-ticket-and-progress-checkpoint), owner 2026-11-01.
-- Preserve the original 420000 ms timeout at the last persisted typing phase; missing counters/analysis are unavailable evidence, not proof of browser errors or data loss. [Origin and diagnostic boundary](../implementation/SPN-134.md#historical-mobile-callback-timeout), agent judgment 2026-11-02, originating in the SPN-071 main push / PR #226.
-- Keep the immutable historical baseline, workload, throttle, first-attempt/no-retry policy, callback caps, input/content checks and existing budgets. A successful candidate or later comparison does not retroactively pass the failed run.
-- Prefer bounded nonsecret phase/process observations in the existing callback fixture. Do not introduce a generic retry framework, instrument primary latency samples or retain credentials/document contents in diagnostics.
-- Initial M covers phase attribution and a bounded fixture/observation repair if demonstrated. Reassess effort before wider investigation; any distinct product defect requires its own evidence-backed scope. Filing a follow-up does not satisfy an unresolved required comparison.
-
-## Out of scope
-
-- SPN-120's named historical fixture cases, native desktop identity/storage cleanup, physical-device provider capability and SPN-133 flush latency.
-- Changing baseline callback behavior, silently skipping a comparison or extending timeouts to obtain a pass.
-
-## Verify
-
-- Inspect the retained baseline partial JSON, job log, failure captures and current callback harness before running anything. Declare a small fixed diagnostic sample, source/browser/runtime and hypothesis; retain all results without assertion retries.
-- Extend the nearest `e2e/doc-responsiveness-callbacks.spec.ts` / fixture / trace-owner tests only where needed. Prove missing input, incomplete tracing and unexpected owned-process exit still fail with the first cause preserved; cleanup must remain bounded.
-- Run the complete existing mobile baseline/candidate comparison on the final source and retain full raw callback evidence, attempt identities, content and input verification, no post-disposal callbacks and cleanup. Verify changed helper/observation dependencies select the required owners. Diagnostics alone do not prove acceptance.

+import { renameSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { rename, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
+
+type Lifecycle = 'page-crash' | 'page-close' | 'context-close' | 'browser-disconnected';
+type Failure =
+  | Lifecycle
+  | 'operation'
+  | 'input-observation'
+  | 'trace'
+  | 'detach'
+  | 'fixture-cleanup'
+  | 'manifest-persistence';
+
+/** Preserve a primary fixture error if writing its evidence also fails. */
+export async function persistCallbackManifest(
+  path: string,
+  evidence: Record<string, unknown>,
+  primary: unknown,
+) {
+  try {
+    await writeFile(`${path}.tmp`, JSON.stringify(evidence, null, 2) + '\n');
+    await rename(`${path}.tmp`, path);
+  } catch {
+    evidence.manifestPersistenceError = true;
+    evidence.passed = false;
+    return primary ?? new Error('Callback acceptance manifest could not be persisted.');
+  }
+  return primary;
+}
+
+/** Node-side observations survive a test-body timeout without querying the renderer.
+ * This is diagnostic evidence only: it cannot replace native acceptance results. */
+export function callbackProgress(path: string) {
+  const started = performance.now();
+  let cleanupExpected = false;
+  let phase = 'fixture';
+  const events: Array<{
+    atMs: number;
+    phase: string;
+    kind: string;
+    count?: number;
+    expected?: boolean;
+  }> = [];
+  let firstFailure: { atMs: number; phase: string; kind: string } | null = null;
+  let droppedEvents = 0;
+  let terminal: string | null = null;
+  let persistenceFailure: { atMs: number; phase: string; code: string } | null = null;
+  const record = (kind: string, extra: { count?: number; expected?: boolean } = {}) => {
+    events.push({ atMs: performance.now() - started, phase, kind, ...extra });
+    // Fixed memory/disk bound even if a broken target emits repeated lifecycle events.
+    if (events.length > 128) {
+      events.shift();
+      droppedEvents++;
+    }
+    try {
+      // Keep the previous complete checkpoint if a write or rename fails. The
+      // fixed temporary path bounds abandoned storage to one additional file.

+# 🔬 SPN-134 — historical mobile callback completion
 
 ## Historical mobile callback timeout
 
@@ -42,3 +42,176 @@ allocation and preserved grooming state. Implementation follows the ticket's
 predeclared bounded sample, fatal/incomplete negative controls, complete current
 mobile comparison and owned-resource cleanup. Keep observations separate from
 primary latency samples and preserve every first attempt without credentials.
+
+## Resume checkpoint and bounded diagnostic protocol
+
+2026-11-02 — branch from main `18a8759c498574a1d9cc24a969a558cd97a798ed`.
+Re-read the archived baseline manifest, Playwright report, job log and both
+screenshots before execution. The report records `timedOut`, 420052 ms, with no
+operation stack. The manifest was written before typing and never updated again.
+The fixture only persists before navigation, before typing and after all trace
+collection/cleanup; later in-memory phases cannot survive a terminated worker.
+The first screenshot shows the files dashboard and the second is blank. Neither
+proves completed content or a cause, but the dashboard is consistent with the
+later ordinary route-disposal path. Treat typing, disposal and collection as
+unresolved alternatives rather than assigning the timeout to input.
+
+Discriminating hypothesis: completion or collection may have stalled after the
+last persisted typing checkpoint. Add bounded Node-side phase/progress and owned
+page/browser lifecycle evidence, independently persisted before awaited input,
+trace and cleanup boundaries. Do not add browser protocol calls per key, alter
+SDK callbacks, primary latency samples, the 420000 ms case deadline or trace
+settings. A terminal test hook must preserve the last observation even when the
+body never finishes. Keep the first observed failure separate from later cleanup
+failures and expected closure. Counts contain no typed text, keys, URLs or tokens.
+
+Predeclared sample: one first-attempt baseline/candidate pair per existing
+preset, selected by the normal callback CI job on the committed instrumented
+source. Baseline remains `0e1df4725d9eccb77574d25e3eecdf678fe6ff44`, Node
+26.12.1, locked Playwright 1.64.1 and its installed Chromium (record actual
+version), Ubuntu runner, identical sixteen paragraphs/2086 keydowns and 4x mobile
+throttle. Preserve every result. No scenario retry, timeout extension, forced GC,
+trace-category change or additional sample solely to seek green. A normal sample
+would establish current comparison completion but leave the original attribution
+limit explicit; a repeated failure must identify its last started/completed
+boundary before deciding any further repair. Unit controls cover missing input,
+incomplete trace and unexpected owned lifecycle termination without browser
+execution. Full paired input/content/callback/disposal checks remain required.
+
+Operator gains a bounded first-failure trail; Owner and Collaborator retain the
+unchanged full native workload and content checks; Link guest keeps existing
+access checks. No production behavior changes. M remains appropriate for this
+observation gap; reassess if evidence requires wider native/runtime repair.
+
+
+## Observation implementation and local controls
+
+The callback-only helper keeps at most 128 recent Node-side events plus the first
+observed failure and terminal test status. Paragraph command starts/completions
+and trace byte counts distinguish pending boundaries without logging content or
+adding per-key renderer requests. Expected page/context closure begins only when
+fixture cleanup starts; browser disconnection and crashes remain unexpected.
+The synchronous terminal hook runs independently of a pending renderer or trace
+promise. These observations are diagnostic; the original input/content/trace
+analyzer and paired acceptance remain authoritative.
+
+Trace retention now lives beside its existing reader. It still closes the owned
+stream once; a failed close cannot replace an earlier read error. Source hashes
+include the new helper on both sides; the workflow's explicit callback copy carries it
+to the immutable baseline and existing dependency routing selects both presets.
+
+Local controls: 41 checks passed, including a real Playwright timeout that returns
+failure and retains its terminal checkpoint without browser launch. Actual stream
+controls verify retained bytes/hash, read-plus-close failure precedence and lone
+close failure. Existing incomplete-input, partial/corrupt trace and paired
+acceptance controls remain passing. Scoped strict types and lint passed after
+recorded small repairs. [Raw local results and source hashes](evidence/SPN-134-local.json)
+retain both failures and current results. No native comparison, historical cause,
+cleanup of a real failed native browser, or final review approval is claimed.
+The original ticket stays open; the PR-shape checker intentionally reports its
+not-yet-prepared landing deletion and completion counter. Final acceptance and
+both independent grades remain required before preparing those landing changes.
+
+
+## Independent review repair before the declared native sample
+
+Both nonimplementing reviewers found that synchronous diagnostic-write exceptions
+could mask the first operation error and bypass owned cleanup. They also found
+raw-file creation occurred after stream acquisition but before its closing guard.
+Both are fixed before any native diagnostic execution: progress persistence uses
+one fixed temporary file and atomic rename, preserves the last complete checkpoint,
+and records a bounded error code without throwing into listeners or cleanup.
+The test body and terminal hook reject unavailable evidence after cleanup; an
+existing operation failure stays primary. All operations after stream acquisition,
+including file creation, now share the one-close guard.
+
+44 focused controls pass (1587 ms guarded elapsed, 587.3 MiB peak). New controls
+make the progress destination unwritable, prove the previous checkpoint is intact,
+keep the original trace-read failure when close also fails, allow cleanup phases,
+and prove missing raw-output parent plus failing close retains the original file
+error while still attempting stream close. Scoped strict types and lint pass.
+The first 41-pass snapshot and earlier type/lint failures remain in the raw record;
+current hashes/results distinguish the repair. Source re-review remains pending,
+with native comparison, original attribution and final acceptance still open.
+
+
+The second review found the same masking path in the main acceptance manifest's
+catch/finally writes. Its callback-specific writer now atomically replaces the
+file, returns any existing primary failure, and records a secondary persistence
+failure without throwing past finalization. A previously successful run still
+fails if evidence cannot be saved. Two actual blocked-path controls cover error
+and finalization writes, continued cleanup, original-error identity, preservation
+of previous bytes and later recovery retaining the failure. All 46 controls pass
+(1601 ms, 584.5 MiB); current scoped strict types and lint pass. Raw results name
+the latest checks explicitly and retain both earlier source snapshots. Native
+execution remains deferred until the source repairs are independently cleared.
+
+## 🔎 Current recurrence and resumed diagnostic plan
+
+2026-11-04 — resume PR #248 on main
+`5d8676ec280ac6d5cc9dcedb7e9cc09527b24806` under the owner's request to
+continue resolving SPN-120's failed CI. Preserve the previous diagnostic source
+`f432b5b890f12dc94c330de719e653d0d8b01aad`; its CI41530973166 and
+Storybook41530973045 were cancelled. Those results do not establish completed
+native diagnostics or acceptance. The earlier statement that a copy glob carried
+the helper was wrong for the callback job: its explicit file list now includes
+the observer. The responsiveness job already copies the matching glob.
+
+SPN-141 source `2f1c9304b15adfef833e53f12c4facff9ce14821`, tested merge
+`a554c611c96556176bcc6b2ba006ea421ee00943`, repeated this existing failure in
+CI41885019303 attempt1, mobile callback job126767285654. The immutable baseline
+timed out at420000ms; candidate passed. Independently reviewed raw trace markers
+show291.546s from input-start to final-key and14.992s through disposal/end.
+The gzip stream is readable through EOF:607927866 uncompressed bytes,
+999293 parsed events. A single offline read on Node26.12.1 took8271ms,
+8492ms watchdog elapsed and431600KiB sampled peak. This is local diagnostic
+measurement, not hosted speed or callback acceptance. Trace parsing completed
+without source attribution; the exact interrupted hosted operation is unknown.
+
+📦 [Immutable first failure, trace, reports, independent reviews and offline measurement](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/tree/46a99b8c1786cb9f80695689c70077ce3ef7cf5d/docs/review-assets/spn-134-recurrence-2f1c9304)
+preserves the evidence before another execution. The missing manifest fields
+mean unavailable observations, not observed browser errors or data loss. The
+timeout reached collection/finalization after the browser's end marker; neither
+the earlier run nor this recurrence passes retroactively. No unchanged job rerun
+is justified. SPN-141's native repair remains independently owned and blocked on
+complete selected checks.
+
+The demonstrated defect repaired here is the missing durable boundary/terminal
+record, including primary-error preservation. M remains appropriate: keep the
+existing callback fixture and reader, bounded Node-side observations and all
+product semantics. Operator gets an attributable first failure; Owner,
+Collaborator and Link guest retain unchanged content, input, access and lifetime
+contracts. No generic retry mechanism, broader collection categories or product
+instrumentation is added.
+
+Prospective sample: after both independent qualifying reviews of the complete
+committed candidate, publish one synchronization of PR #248 to run its ordinary
+selected CI, including one first-attempt baseline/candidate pair for each preset.
+The hypothesis is that the diagnostic repair preserves a precise pending
+boundary and terminal cause if completion fails, while complete executions still
+pass the original paired acceptance. Keep Node26.12.1, locked Playwright1.64.1,
+actual recorded Chromium version, baseline0e1df472, 2086 keydowns, mobile4x,
+420000ms, categories/buffer, callback caps and all existing assertions. No failed
+scenario retry or further browser sample is preauthorized by this plan. Inspect
+any failure before a new repair or protocol; a successful pair establishes only
+current completion and leaves the historical attribution limit explicit.
+
+Local controls cover stalled input/trace, terminal timeouts without a browser,
+unexpected owned closure, persistence and stream-close failure precedence,
+truncated/corrupt raw evidence, incomplete input and automatic dependency routing.
+Current source integration passed47 focused controls in1711ms watchdog elapsed,
+610624KiB sampled peak. Final feasible type/lint/backlog checks and both exact-head
+grades precede publication. Hosted comparison, actual cleanup and all seven
+current-head gates remain pending; no grade substitutes for them. Landing
+bookkeeping is prepared before review under the newer review-before-push rule,
+superseding this record's older plan to defer deletion until after CI. The PR
+stays draft until required acceptance and the failure disposition are complete.
+
+✅ [Current local results and source hashes](evidence/SPN-134-resume.json)
+retain the 47 controls, full lint/dependency/format pass, and focused typecheck of
+the callback helpers, validators and tests. Full typecheck was resource-aborted
+at 2145 ms when host memory pressure rose to level 2 (1491424 KiB process tree);
+it remains pending in CI. Focused types do not cover the browser spec, and a
+sub-250 ms run does not measure the native compiler's peak RSS. No owner apps
+were terminated. The repeated failure's precise collection boundary still needs
+the declared instrumented comparison; local controls do not prove native timing.

-# 🔬 SPN-134 Diagnose incomplete historical mobile callback runs
-
-## Story
-
-As the [Operator](../product/personas.md#operator), I want an incomplete historical callback run to identify its failing phase and cause, so that a required comparison can be repaired without uncertain reruns.
-
-## Scenarios
-
-### An incomplete baseline has an evidence-backed disposition
-
-Given the retained historical mobile callback timeout,
-When its owned browser, input, tracing and cleanup boundaries are inspected,
-Then the original failure has a supported cause and bounded repair or explicit follow-up owner,
-And a complete historical/candidate comparison still proves input, content and callback ownership.
-
-## Rules
-
-- Follow [sustainable testing](../testing.md); keep the Verify plan and progress evidence current. [Policy](../implementation/SPN-115.md#guidance-for-every-open-ticket-and-progress-checkpoint), owner 2026-11-01.
-- Preserve the original 420000 ms timeout at the last persisted typing phase; missing counters/analysis are unavailable evidence, not proof of browser errors or data loss. [Origin and diagnostic boundary](../implementation/SPN-134.md#historical-mobile-callback-timeout), agent judgment 2026-11-02, originating in the SPN-071 main push / PR #226.
-- Keep the immutable historical baseline, workload, throttle, first-attempt/no-retry policy, callback caps, input/content checks and existing budgets. A successful candidate or later comparison does not retroactively pass the failed run.
-- Prefer bounded nonsecret phase/process observations in the existing callback fixture. Do not introduce a generic retry framework, instrument primary latency samples or retain credentials/document contents in diagnostics.
-- Initial M covers phase attribution and a bounded fixture/observation repair if demonstrated. Reassess effort before wider investigation; any distinct product defect requires its own evidence-backed scope. Filing a follow-up does not satisfy an unresolved required comparison.
-
-## Out of scope
-
-- SPN-120's named historical fixture cases, native desktop identity/storage cleanup, physical-device provider capability and SPN-133 flush latency.
-- Changing baseline callback behavior, silently skipping a comparison or extending timeouts to obtain a pass.
-
-## Verify
-
-- Inspect the retained baseline partial JSON, job log, failure captures and current callback harness before running anything. Declare a small fixed diagnostic sample, source/browser/runtime and hypothesis; retain all results without assertion retries.
-- Extend the nearest `e2e/doc-responsiveness-callbacks.spec.ts` / fixture / trace-owner tests only where needed. Prove missing input, incomplete tracing and unexpected owned-process exit still fail with the first cause preserved; cleanup must remain bounded.
-- Run the complete existing mobile baseline/candidate comparison on the final source and retain full raw callback evidence, attempt identities, content and input verification, no post-disposal callbacks and cleanup. Verify changed helper/observation dependencies select the required owners. Diagnostics alone do not prove acceptance.

+import { renameSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { rename, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';

+type Lifecycle = 'page-crash' | 'page-close' | 'context-close' | 'browser-disconnected';
+type Failure =
+  | Lifecycle
+  | 'operation'
+  | 'input-observation'
+  | 'trace'
+  | 'detach'
+  | 'fixture-cleanup'
+  | 'manifest-persistence';
+
+/** Preserve a primary fixture error if writing its evidence also fails. */
+export async function persistCallbackManifest(
+  path: string,
+  evidence: Record<string, unknown>,
+  primary: unknown,
+) {
+  try {
+    await writeFile(`${path}.tmp`, JSON.stringify(evidence, null, 2) + '\n');
+    await rename(`${path}.tmp`, path);
+  } catch {
+    evidence.manifestPersistenceError = true;
+    evidence.passed = false;
+    return primary ?? new Error('Callback acceptance manifest could not be persisted.');
+  }
+  return primary;
+}
+
+/** Node-side observations survive a test-body timeout without querying the renderer.
+ * This is diagnostic evidence only: it cannot replace native acceptance results. */

+## Resume checkpoint and bounded diagnostic protocol
+

+later ordinary route-disposal path. Treat typing, disposal and collection as
+unresolved alternatives rather than assigning the timeout to input.

+last persisted typing checkpoint. Add bounded Node-side phase/progress and owned
+page/browser lifecycle evidence, independently persisted before awaited input,
+trace and cleanup boundaries. Do not add browser protocol calls per key, alter
+SDK callbacks, primary latency samples, the 420000 ms case deadline or trace
+settings. A terminal test hook must preserve the last observation even when the

+failures and expected closure. Counts contain no typed text, keys, URLs or tokens.
